fact: The health ministry reports that at the Thierno Birahim Ndao regional hospital in Kaffrine, a pilot site, the patient record has been digital since November 2024: the patient is created in the Dossier Patient Informatisé at registration, the doctor enters observations directly in the system after the interview, and each patient has a single record consultable in real time by the hospital's professionals in whichever service, with more than 26,000 patients registered; retrieval at another facility is not stated.
title: Digitalisation hospitalière : le Centre Hospitalier régional Thierno Biraahim Ndao de Kaffrine trace la voie d'un système de santé moderne
publisher: Ministère de la Santé et de l'Hygiène publique
